#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <queue>
#include <numeric>

using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int from, to;
    int capacity;
    int cost;
    int flow;
    Edge* complement;
    Edge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) : from(from), to(to), capacity(capacity), cost(cost), flow(0), complement(nullptr) {}
};

struct MinHeap {
    int n;
    int pos;
    vector<int> a, map, imap;
    static const int INF = INT_MAX;

    MinHeap(int m) : n(m+2), pos(1) {
        a.assign(n, INF);
        map.assign(n, -1);
        imap.assign(n, -1);
    }

    int add(int ind, int x) {
        int ret = imap[ind];
        if (imap[ind] < 0) {
            a[pos] = x;
            map[pos] = ind;
            imap[ind] = pos;
            pos++;
            up(pos-1);
        }
        return (ret != -1) ? a[ret] : x;
    }

    int update(int ind, int x) {
        int ret = imap[ind];
        if (imap[ind] < 0) {
            a[pos] = x;
            map[pos] = ind;
            imap[ind] = pos;
            pos++;
            up(pos-1);
        } else {
            a[ret] = x;
            up(ret);
            down(ret);
        }
        return x;
    }

    int remove(int ind) {
        if (pos == 1) return INF;
        if (imap[ind] == -1) return INF;
        pos--;
        int rem = imap[ind];
        int ret = a[rem];
        map[rem] = map[pos];
        imap[map[pos]] = rem;
        imap[ind] = -1;
        a[rem] = a[pos];
        a[pos] = INF;
        map[pos] = -1;
        up(rem);
        down(rem);
        return ret;
    }

    int min() { return a[1]; }
    int argmin() { return map[1]; }
    int size() { return pos-1; }

    void up(int cur) {
        for (int c = cur, p = c >> 1; p >= 1 && a[p] > a[c]; c >>= 1, p >>= 1) {
            swap(a[p], a[c]);
            swap(imap[map[p]], imap[map[c]]);
            swap(map[p], map[c]);
        }
    }

    void down(int cur) {
        for (int c = cur; 2*c < pos; ) {
            int b = (a[2*c] < a[2*c+1]) ? 2*c : 2*c+1;
            if (a[b] < a[c]) {
                swap(a[c], a[b]);
                swap(imap[map[c]], imap[map[b]]);
                swap(map[c], map[b]);
                c = b;
            } else break;
        }
    }
};

vector<vector<Edge*>> compileWD(int n, vector<Edge>& edges) {
    vector<vector<Edge*>> g(n);
    for (int i = (int)edges.size()-1; i >= 0; i--) {
        Edge& origin = edges[i];
        Edge* clone = new Edge(origin.to, origin.from, origin.capacity, -origin.cost);
        clone->flow = origin.capacity;
        clone->complement = &origin;
        origin.complement = clone;
        edges.push_back(*clone);
    }
    vector<int> p(n, 0);
    for (Edge& e : edges) p[e.from]++;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i].reserve(p[i]);
    for (Edge& e : edges) g[e.from].push_back(&e);
    return g;
}

long long solveMinCostFlow(vector<vector<Edge*>>& g, int source, int sink, long long all) {
    int n = g.size();
    long long mincost = 0;
    vector<int> potential(n, 0);
    vector<int> d(n);
    MinHeap q(n);
    while (all > 0) {
        fill(d.begin(), d.end(), INT_MAX / 2);
        d[source] = 0;
        q = MinHeap(n);
        q.add(source, 0);
        vector<Edge*> inedge(n, nullptr);
        while (q.size() > 0) {
            int cur = q.argmin();
            q.remove(cur);
            for (Edge* ne : g[cur]) {
                if (ne->capacity - ne->flow > 0) {
                    int nd = d[cur] + ne->cost + potential[cur] - potential[ne->to];
                    if (d[ne->to] > nd) {
                        inedge[ne->to] = ne;
                        d[ne->to] = nd;
                        q.update(ne->to, nd);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (inedge[sink] == nullptr) break;

        long long minflow = all;
        long long sumcost = 0;
        for (Edge* e = inedge[sink]; e != nullptr; e = inedge[e->from]) {
            if (e->capacity - e->flow < minflow) minflow = e->capacity - e->flow;
            sumcost += e->cost;
        }
        mincost += minflow * sumcost;
        for (Edge* e = inedge[sink]; e != nullptr; e = inedge[e->from]) {
            e->flow += minflow;
            e->complement->flow -= minflow;
        }
        all -= minflow;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) potential[i] += d[i];
    }
    return mincost;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) cin >> a[i];

    vector<int> f(26, 0);
    for (char c : s) f[c-'a']++;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        if (f[i] > n/2) {
            cout << -1 << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n/2; i++) {
        if (a[i] > a[n-1-i]) {
            swap(a[i], a[n-1-i]);
            swap(s[i], s[n-1-i]);
        }
    }

    vector<Edge> es;
    int src = n, sink = n+1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n/2; i++) {
        es.emplace_back(src, i, 1, 0);
        es.emplace_back(n-1-i, sink, 1, 0);
        for (int j = 0; j < n/2; j++) {
            if (s[i] != s[n-1-j]) {
                es.emplace_back(i, n-1-j, 1, (i == j) ? 0 : a[i]);
            }
        }
    }

    long long total = accumulate(a.begin(), a.end(), 0LL);
    auto g = compileWD(sink+1, es);
    long long mincost = solveMinCostFlow(g, src, sink, n/2);
    cout << total - mincost << endl;

    // Clean up edges? Not necessary for contest.
    return 0;
}
